name: fovuxstudiokit
description: Visual companion for Fovux MCP — run dashboards, dataset inspector, export wizard.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Fovux Studio Kit can display runs and models in untrusted workspaces but cannot start servers or launch training.

commands.title: Fovux: Reveal Run in File Explorer

languageModelTools.name: fovux_call_tool
languageModelTools.modelDescription: (Advanced/Fallback only) Call a generic fovux-mcp tool. PREFER using the specific granular tools (e.g. fovux_train_start, fovux_dataset_inspect) whenever possible. Only use fovux_call_tool if no specific tool covers the required operation.

tool.description: The fovux-mcp tool name, for example train_status or dataset_inspect.

args.description: JSON object passed as the tool arguments.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Call Fovux MCP Tool using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_inspect_dataset
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Produce comprehensive statistics and quality metrics for a dataset. Use when you need to check class balance, Gini index, image sizes, or get an auto-fix recommendation plan. DO NOT use for deep structural checks (use fovux_dataset_validate instead) or perceptual duplicate search (use fovux_dataset_find_duplicates).

dataset_path.description: Path to the YOLO dataset directory containing data.yaml.

include_samples.description: Whether to include sample image paths in the output report.

max_images_analyzed.description: Cap on the number of images to read to prevent timeouts.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Inspect Dataset using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_validate_dataset
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Validate a YOLO/COCO dataset for structural correctness. Checks data.yaml, image-label pairing, and annotation format. Use to ensure the dataset is ready for training. DO NOT use if you only want descriptive statistics (use fovux_dataset_inspect instead).

dataset_path.description: Path to the YOLO dataset directory.

check_image_readable.description: Verify that all image files can be loaded by PIL without corruption.

check_bbox_bounds.description: Ensure bbox coordinates lie strictly within [0.0, 1.0].

check_class_id_range.description: Ensure annotated class IDs match the categories defined in dataset metadata.

strict.description: Fail on warnings as well as critical errors.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Validate Dataset using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_find_dataset_duplicates
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Detect duplicate or near-duplicate images in a YOLO dataset using perceptual hashing. Use to clean redundant training data and resolve split leakage. DO NOT use for general file comparison or structural validation.

dataset_path.description: Path to the YOLO dataset directory.

hamming_threshold.description: Maximum hamming distance (0-64) for near-duplicates. Lower values mean stricter matching.

across_splits.description: Detect duplicate images leaked between train, val, or test splits.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Find Dataset Duplicates using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_check_annotation_quality
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run targeted heuristic checks for common bounding box anomalies (out of bounds, extremely tiny, highly overlapping, empty). Use to clean up annotation quality before training. DO NOT use for general dataset structure (use fovux_dataset_validate).

dataset_path.description: Path to the YOLO/COCO dataset directory.

checks.description: Specific checks to run. If empty, runs all checks.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Annotation Quality Check using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_start_train
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Launch a new YOLO training run as a non-blocking background subprocess. Use this to start training after preflight/validation checks are successful. DO NOT use if there is an active training run unless force=True or max_concurrent_runs is increased.

dataset_path.description: Path to the YOLO training dataset.

model.description: Model architecture file or checkpoint to start from.

device.description: Compute device to run training on (auto, cpu, cuda GPU index).

name.description: Explicit run identifier. If omitted, a random ID is generated.

force.description: Overwrite existing run directory if it exists with the same name.

max_concurrent_runs.description: Limit on concurrent active runs. Restricts resource exhaustion.

max_runtime_seconds.description: Hard time budget in seconds before automatic run termination.

max_disk_usage_gb.description: Hard disk budget in gigabytes for saved checkpoints.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Start Training using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_preflight_train
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run safety and diagnostic preflight checks before launching training. Checks dataset validity, model source, device availability, disk budgets, and run directory collisions. Use to prevent runtime training failures. DO NOT use to launch training (use fovux_train_start instead).

dataset_path.description: Path to the YOLO training dataset.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Training Preflight Check using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_get_train_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get current metrics and process state for an ongoing or completed YOLO training run. Use to check if training is complete or monitor loss. DO NOT use to stop training (use fovux_train_stop instead).

run_id.description: ID of the training run to check.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Training Status using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_stop_train
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Stop a running YOLO training run by its run ID. Use to abort training that is overfitting or taking too long. DO NOT use for idle or completed runs.

run_id.description: ID of the training run to stop.

force.description: Force kill the process group immediately using SIGKILL if it hangs.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Stop Training using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_resume_train
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Resume a stopped or failed training run from its last checkpoint (weights/last.pt). Use when training was interrupted (e.g. system reboot or timeout). DO NOT use for starting a clean run (use fovux_train_start instead).

run_id.description: ID of the training run to resume.

epochs.description: Optionally adjust the total number of epochs for the resumed training run.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Resume Training using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_run_eval
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Evaluate a YOLO model checkpoint against a validation dataset and return mAP metrics. Use to test performance of a trained model. DO NOT use during active training on the same run (wait until it is paused or completed).

checkpoint.description: Model checkpoint path (absolute or relative to FOVUX_HOME/models).

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Run Evaluation using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_compare_eval
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Evaluate multiple checkpoints on the same dataset side-by-side and rank them by mAP50. Use to choose the best model architecture or epoch checkpoint. DO NOT use to compare training run telemetry (use fovux_run_compare instead).

checkpoints.description: List of model checkpoints to evaluate.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Compare Evaluations using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_compare_run
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Compare training runs on shared loss, metrics, and parameters, producing a markdown report and comparison charts. Use to trace training history and compare hyperparameter sets. DO NOT use to run fresh validation evaluations (use fovux_eval_compare instead).

run_ids.description: List of run IDs to compare. If empty, all non-archived runs are compared.

output_path.description: Optional output markdown filepath to write the report to.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Compare Training Runs using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_export_onnx
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Export a PyTorch YOLO checkpoint to ONNX format with configurable opset and parity verification. Use for cross-platform CPU/GPU inference or browser deployment. DO NOT use for mobile android deployment (use fovux_export_tflite instead).

output_path.description: Optional custom output path for the ONNX file.

simplify.description: Optimize ONNX graph structures via onnxsimplifier.

nms.description: Embed CoreML/ONNX Non-Maximum Suppression directly inside the model graph.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Export to ONNX using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_export_tflite
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Export a YOLO checkpoint to TensorFlow Lite format. Use for mobile (Android/iOS) and Raspberry Pi edge deployments. DO NOT use for high-performance server GPU hosting (use fovux_export_onnx or TensorRT instead).

output_path.description: Optional custom output path for the .tflite file.

int8.description: Convert model weights to INT8 integer values (requires calibration dataset).

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Export to TFLite using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_quantize_int8
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Quantize a model to INT8 precision using a calibration dataset. Use to speed up inference and shrink model sizes on CPU/edge targets. DO NOT use if you cannot provide a calibration dataset (which prevents accurate quantization).

calibration_dataset.description: Path to a representative calibration dataset directory.

output_path.description: Optional custom output path for the quantized model.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Quantize INT8 using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_advise_deployment
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyze deployment readiness for an exported model on a target platform profile. Checks formats, sizes, compatibility, quantization options, and generates integration code snippets. Use to guide edge deployment planning. DO NOT use for general model profiling (use fovux_model_profile instead).

model_path.description: Path to the exported model file (.onnx, .tflite, .engine).

dataset_path.description: Optional validation dataset to run accuracy and parity benchmarks.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Deployment Advice using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_profile_model
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Profile a YOLO model checkpoint to measure parameters, FLOPs, layer count, memory footprint, and disk size. Use to assess if a model can fit on hardware resource budgets. DO NOT use to assess platform-specific deployment features (use fovux_deployment_advise instead).

device.description: Device to run profiling benchmarks on.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Profile Model using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_delete_run
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delete a training run from registry and optionally clean up its directory in the filesystem. Use to free up disk space by deleting failed or junk runs. DO NOT use on currently running training processes unless force=True.

run_id.description: ID of the training run to delete.

delete_files.description: Whether to delete the run directory and all saved weights from disk.

force.description: Terminate the run first if it is currently active, then delete.

dry_run.description: Calculate what files would be deleted without actually removing them.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Delete Run using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_tag_run
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replace or add tags to a training run for filtering, grouping, and workspace organization. Use to mark runs as 'baseline', 'candidate', etc. DO NOT use to start or configure runs (set tags in fovux_train_start instead).

run_id.description: ID of the training run to tag.

tags.description: Complete list of new tags for the run.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux Tag Run using the local fovux-mcp server.

languageModelTools.name: fovux_run_doctor
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a comprehensive diagnostic health check covering CUDA, GPU availability, disk limits, dependencies, and local Fovux server status. Use to diagnose setup issues, GPU driver failures, or connection errors. DO NOT use for training parameters or dataset inspection.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run Fovux System Doctor using the local fovux-mcp server.
